page_title: PAL 2-0 GET | Las Palmas v Getafe 01/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows for the end of today's match.

90+8' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) wasted a huge opportunity! The fans already began to celebrate as he produced a shot from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort. The ball went towards the bottom right corner, but Alvaro Valles made an astonishing save!
90+7' A corner kick by Getafe is thwarted by the well prepared Alvaro Valles (Las Palmas).
90+7' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. The ball is out of play. Getafe will have a chance to score from a corner.
90+4' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta has decided to make a change. Benito Ramirez (Las Palmas) replaces Alberto Moleiro.
90+4' We are about to witness a subsitution. Daley Sinkgraven (Las Palmas) for Kirian Rodriguez.
90+2' 2 - 0 Goal! Marvin puts the ball on a plate for Cristian Herrera (Las Palmas), who scores with a simple close-range finish. It's 2:0.
90+1' Fabrizio Angileri (Getafe) makes a bad challenge on his opponent and is booked by the referee.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
89' Substitution. Fabrizio Angileri (Getafe) in, Diego Rico out.
89' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Las Palmas due to an offside in the build-up play.
89' The Las Palmas players halt their celebrations as referee Mateo Busquets Ferrer makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
88' Goal! The rebound fell to Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) and he fired home from close range. The score is 2:0.
88' A pass from Julian Araujo (Las Palmas) is intercepted by David Soria and the move breaks down.
86' The free kick from long range, taken by Getafe, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
85' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Sandro Ramirez trots off the pitch and is replaced by Cristian Herrera (Las Palmas).
84' Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Mateo Busquets Ferrer blows his whistle for a foul. Getafe get a free kick.

82' Diego Rico (Getafe) collects a rebound a long way out and doesn't hesitate to release a goal-bound hammer of a shot. His attempt is precise and low towards the middle of the target. It would have ended in the back of the net if it wasn't for Alvaro Valles and his nice save.
80' Jose Bordalas Jimenez prepares a substitution. Borja Mayoral is replaced by Choco Lozano (Getafe).
79' Here comes a substitution. Damian Suarez is given a rest as he is replaced by Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe).
78' The free kick from long range, taken by Getafe, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
77' Marvin (Las Palmas) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Mateo Busquets Ferrer has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Getafe earn a free kick.
74' Javier Munoz (Las Palmas) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.

73' Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) collects a simple pass and decides to shoot from distance. It's a swerving effort aimed low towards the middle of the goal, but David Soria reads it well and makes a comfortable save.

71' Sandro Ramirez nearly gets in a one-on-one with the goalkeeper after a defence-splitting pass from Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas), but one of the defenders makes a clearance to snuff out the chance.
70' Luis Milla (Getafe) is arguing with the referee and is given a caution.
70' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) fires the ball in from a mid-range free kick, but it blazes over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Getafe.
69' Diego Rico (Getafe) has tested the patience of referee Mateo Busquets Ferrer and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
66' Marvin (Las Palmas) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Getafe.
63' Substitution. Munir El Haddadi makes his way off the pitch and Maximo Perrone (Las Palmas) comes on as his replacement.
63' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta has decided to substitute Enzo Loiodice and he is replaced by Marvin (Las Palmas).
62' Julian Araujo (Las Palmas) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Mateo Busquets Ferrer blows for a foul.

61' Saul Coco (Las Palmas) strikes with a bullet header after a well-executed corner kick deep into the box. The ball goes close to the right post, but is superbly blocked and deflected onto the post by the goalkeeper.
61' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
60' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The referee blows his whistle, Las Palmas are awarded a corner kick.
60' The ball is cleared after Nemanja Maksimovic (Getafe) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.

59' Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) attempts to release Sandro Ramirez with a through ball, but his effort is thwarted by one of the defending players. The ball goes out of play and Getafe will have a goal kick.
56' PENALTY APPEAL after Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
55' Damian Suarez (Getafe) criticises the decision of the referee and immediately receives a yellow card.

55' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a low strike towards the middle of the goal. David Soria guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.

54' Borja Mayoral (Getafe) gets the ball from a rebound and thumps a terrific long-range shot towards the net. Unfortunately for him, it sails narrowly wide of the right post. Unlucky finish. The ball goes out of play and Las Palmas will have a goal kick.
53' Jose Bordalas Jimenez decides to make a substitution. Oscar Rodriguez will be replaced by Domingos Duarte (Getafe).
53' Borja Mayoral (Getafe) is caught offside after the linesman raises his flag.
53' Luis Milla (Getafe) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
52' Getafe take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Getafe.
51' Juanmi Latasa (Getafe) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball is out of play and Getafe manage to earn a corner.
48' The ref signals that VAR has overturned that yellow card and upgraded it to a straight red for Omar Alderete (Getafe). He’s got to go!
47' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident from earlier. This could be a red card for Omar Alderete (Getafe)! Let's see what he decides.
46' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Omar Alderete (Getafe) was quite harsh and Mateo Busquets Ferrer didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
46' Jose Bordalas Jimenez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Juanmi Latasa (Getafe) replacing Djene.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+5' The match has reached half-time.
45+4' The resulting set piece from Las Palmas is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
45+3' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Las Palmas. The ball goes out of play and Las Palmas have been awarded a corner kick.

45+2' David Soria pulls off a great save to deny Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom right corner. The ball goes behind for a corner. Las Palmas will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
45' Some patient build-up play from Las Palmas as they look to unlock the defence.
43' 1 - 0 Goal! Kirian Rodriguez swings the ball deep into the box and finds Julian Araujo (Las Palmas) unmarked, and his close-range header flies past the keeper into the bottom right corner. 1:0.
42' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) commits a foul during an attacking move.
40' Ball possession – 71:29.
39' Sergi Cardona (Las Palmas) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Mateo Busquets Ferrer blows his whistle for a foul. Getafe win a free kick.
37' Omar Alderete (Getafe) sends a cross into the box, but Alvaro Valles comes off his line to gather the ball.
37' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
35' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Getafe, is overhit and the ball goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Las Palmas will have a goal kick.
33' Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but David Soria comes off the line to clear the ball away.
32' Javier Munoz (Las Palmas) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
30' The ball rebounds to Mason Greenwood (Getafe) inside the box after a goalmouth scramble, but he whips the ball high over bar. The ball goes out of play and Las Palmas will have a goal kick.
30' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) sprays a pass out to Nemanja Maksimovic, but he can't beat his man inside the box.
30' Djene (Getafe) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
29' Djene (Getafe) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
26' Damian Suarez (Getafe) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. Las Palmas are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
23' Las Palmas have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
23' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Enzo Loiodice (Las Palmas) is thwarted and cleared to safety. Las Palmas force their opponents to concede a corner.
23' A dangerous attempt from Damian Suarez (Getafe) was aimed towards the roof of the net, but Alvaro Valles pulls off a superb save and stops this one.
22' Borja Mayoral (Getafe) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
20' Diego Rico (Getafe) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
19' The Las Palmas players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
18' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Oscar Rodriguez (Getafe).
17' A goal, which was scored by Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas), was disallowed due to offside.

15' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) steadies himself on the edge of the box and releases a precise effort on goal that just narrowly sails past the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Las Palmas.
14' Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
11' Confusion here but it seems that referee Mateo Busquets Ferrer has changed his mind following the VAR review and downgraded the red card shown to Oscar Rodriguez (Getafe) to a yellow.

11' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Oscar Rodriguez (Getafe), but referee Mateo Busquets Ferrer must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
9' Oscar Rodriguez (Getafe) is shown a red card by the referee for a horror tackle that simply has no place in football!
5' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Las Palmas.
3' Alvaro Valles comes off his line to intercept the corner from Luis Milla (Getafe).
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Las Palmas will have the kick-off.
Mateo Busquets Ferrer is the one to supervise the game today.
